svg.title: P3 · Messaging through RabbitMQ
svg.desc: Message flow, left to right. Publishers write an outbox row in the same transaction and publish with confirms; consumers acknowledge after commit and deduplicate by eventId (ADR-003).
svg.text: Message flow, left to right. Publishers write an outbox row in the same transaction and publish with confirms; consumers acknowledge after commit and deduplicate by eventId (ADR-003).

g.text: One node · one user per service, least privilege

svg.text: Binding labels name the events each queue receives (ADR-003); exact routing keys belong in the AsyncAPI document, not written yet. Every queue dead-letters the same way; one path is drawn. Whether ReportSubmitted and other Issue-only events are published is open (ADR-001).
